title: Mock exam definition
description: One exam framework (Goethe B1, DELF B1, DELE B1 …) as data: sections → parts → item types, timings, play limits, scoring and pass lines, the exam-locale with the runner's UI strings, and the result-file adapter. The engine (domain/grade.js, src/features/exam) reads only this; content/exams/<id>/exam.json. The tests themselves are separate files (tests.file, validated by tests.schema). Paths ('lesen.teil2.texts', 'items') are dot paths into a test file, or into the group a part repeats over. String fields named instruction, summary, rules, intro, hint, recordHint, groupLabel and the itemTypes' labels are keys of the exam-locale catalog.

locale.description: exam-locale id: content/exams/<id>/locale.<locale>.json (exam-locale@1), the runner's strings in the exam's language

adapter.description: result-file adapter (src/features/exam/adapters.js): names and shapes of the files an attempt becomes

test.description: folder of one test under base; {nn} is the two-digit test number

passShare.description: share of a section's maximum that passes

answers.description: how a given answer is compared: trimmed and lower case

blank.description: an item left blank counts as wrong

key.description: how the stored answer becomes the correct value: bool → true/false values; index → values[answer]; value → the answer itself (none when empty)

options.description: row: side by side; stack: one per line; letters: letter buttons for a matching task

labels.description: locale keys of the option labels, or the part's speakers

badge.description: show the value (a, b, c) before each option

text.description: the item's text for lists and reviews; {field} is a field of the item

graded.description: not scored in the app: a correction gives the score

id.description: play-count key; {i} is the group number

readSeconds.description: reading time before the first play

replayAfter.description: the next play starts by itself after this many seconds

id.description: objective parts: the Teil code in result rows (L1, H4); writing and speaking parts: the task id in result rows

anyOf.description: the type is the item's own field, mapped

first.description: the printed number of the part's first item

layout.description: split: text beside its items; match: situations and a choice list; list: items under a lead; block: a recording with its items

renumber.description: '<word> 1–N' in the intro becomes the printed numbers

fields.description: writing: the task's fields shown, in order

kind.description: speaking: plan with a partner whose lines are heard; present slide by slide; answer the examiner's questions

reviewLabel.description: speaking: the heading of the part's recordings in the review

topicPrefix.description: a pattern removed from the topic on the slides

id.description: module id in routes, drafts and result files

clock.description: down: time left; up: time used (no limit shown)

soundCheck.description: a test's recording the start panel plays as a sound check

prepMinutes.description: speaking: preparation time on the clock

planMinutes.description: minutes the module takes in a day's plan, when not `minutes`
